# Synthetic backup fixtures

Generated by `tests/Mapo.Tests/Program.cs` using the field numbers from official Mihon and inherited Tachiyomi sources. No user backups or credentials are included. These are schema-conformant synthetic fixtures, not claims of an anonymized real-device corpus.

- `mihon-current.tachibk`: gzip protobuf, Unicode title, tracker ID, packed category ID, fractional read chapter, new field 109.
- `tachiyomi-protobuf.proto.gz`: shared protobuf family.
- `tachiyomi-v2.json`: original legacy array manga and compact tracker/chapter keys.
- `corrupted.tachibk`, `unsupported.json`: deliberate rejection cases.
- `missing-metadata.proto`: no tracker/status/score/author/progress.
- `unicode-duplicates.proto`: Japanese/Korean/Chinese/Thai/Arabic/Cyrillic and duplicate title records.
- `multiple-sources.proto`: different source IDs.
- `large-10000.tachibk`: 10,000 synthetic entries.

Tracker media IDs are arbitrary test identifiers. Do not import these fixtures into a real account without replacing/confirming their IDs.
